item.title: P99 From 280 ms to 58 ms by Making the Queue Fair
item.description: A third-party Laravel runtime comparison put ePHPm’s worker mode at the top on throughput. It was about 19% ahead of FrankenPHP on /api/static. It was also at the bottom of the fast group on tail latency, with a P99 of 157 ms against FrankenPHP’s 57 ms. Best throughput plus the fattest tail is a shape worth chasing, because fast execution can’t produce it. Making requests faster lowers the mean and the tail. Only waiting can pull them apart. Specifically, unfair waiting.
